## Description {#details}

<p>A name prepared for a single TAP line, without a copy when it needs no change.</p>


<p>The names of the suites and of the test cases rarely contain a character that <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/anonymous-reporter-tap-cpp-/#aec79a35b7936b91bee63d9baf4f8c861">tap_text()</a></span> changes, so the name is searched, and only copied (with <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/anonymous-reporter-tap-cpp-/#aec79a35b7936b91bee63d9baf4f8c861">tap_text()</a></span>) when it must be changed; otherwise <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#af66d5eee86e8fa54fb3d8f36177fb60b">c_str()</a></span> returns the original name, which must outlive the object. The object is neither copyable nor movable.</p>


<p>Definition at line 151 of file <a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/files/src/reporter-tap-cpp">reporter-tap.cpp</a>.</p>
